note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 38(2), ZIM 4; A06b Const 38(2), ZIM 4; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Zimbabwe, 2024
sources.said: Person has been continuously and lawfully resident in Zimbabwe for at least 10 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person has acquired citizenship of another state. Note: In February 2020, the Cabinet approved the revised Zimbabwean Citizenship Bill, which allows Zimbabweans by descent to hold dual citizenship.
